_meta.note: The irrigation zone flow check's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `zoneflow.`.

strings.zoneflow.low: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}. Something is holding water back: a clogged nozzle or screen, a filter, or a valve not opening fully.
strings.zoneflow.low_sized_spray_full: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}: the missing flow is about what {heads:.0f} full-circle spray head(s) of {size:.0f} feet give. Look for a clogged nozzle or screen.
strings.zoneflow.low_sized_spray_half: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}: the missing flow is about what {heads:.0f} half-circle spray head(s) of {size:.0f} feet give. Look for a clogged nozzle or screen.
strings.zoneflow.low_sized_spray_quarter: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}: the missing flow is about what {heads:.0f} quarter-circle spray head(s) of {size:.0f} feet give. Look for a clogged nozzle or screen.
strings.zoneflow.low_sized_rotor: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}: the missing flow is about what {heads:.0f} rotor(s) with a #{size:.1f} nozzle give. Look for a stuck rotor or a clogged nozzle.
strings.zoneflow.low_sized_emitter: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}: the missing flow is about what {heads:.0f} emitter(s) of {size:.1f} gph give. Look for clogged emitters or a dirty filter.
strings.zoneflow.high: {zone} ran at {flow:.1f} gpm, {percent:.0f}% of its usual {usual:.1f}. Water is getting out where it should not: a broken head, a lost nozzle, or a leak. Walk the zone while it runs.
strings.zoneflow.drift: {zone} has run at {of_expected:.0f}% of what its heads should give ({expected:.1f} gpm) over its recent runs: emitters or nozzles clogging slowly, or a filter filling. Clean the filter and check the heads.
